_note: Narration script for the Team Leader crewing gaps module (Team Leader guide section 5, Crewing gaps). Written by Claude from the guide, for the owner to review. Lee voice on eleven_v4, [calmly] prefix, two takes (scenes 1 to 4, then 5 to 8).

lines.head: Introduction
sentences: Crewing gaps.
Where your rosters fall below your own minimum.

lines.head: What it does
sentences: It checks the next eight days of your teams' rosters.
And finds the hours that don't meet your rules.
It only finds the gaps. You decide what to do about each one.

lines.head: Your rules
sentences: Open Your rules, and tap Add a group.
A group is one or more teams, checked together.
Tick the teams, and set the minimum crew across the group.

lines.head: Who counts
sentences: Then choose who counts, level by level.
A new group starts with paramedics, AOs and ARs counting.
Assists count only with one of those in the same town.
And recruits don't count.

lines.head: Save
sentences: Choose the shortest gap to list, then tap Save rules.
Your rules are yours only.

lines.head: Reading the results
sentences: Each group shows how many gaps, and how many hours.
A bar for each day, with the gaps in red.
Gaps are counted by shift: day, eight till six, and night, six till eight.
Tap Who's booked to see who's on.

lines.head: Towns and sharing
sentences: For a group of two or more teams, it also lists any town with nobody counted in its own right.
And Copy as text puts the list into a message or an email.

lines.head: Summary
sentences: Set your groups.
Check the gaps.
Then decide what to do.
